PrivacyPage.heading: Privacy notice
PrivacyPage.draft: This is a draft. We're finalising it before the website opens to customers.
PrivacyPage.intro: This notice explains what personal data the {brand} website keeps about you, why, who helps us handle it, how long we keep it, and what you can ask us to do. {brand} is one garage, at {address}.

data.title: What we keep, and why
data.lead: The website keeps personal data only when you log in. Here is each thing it keeps.

number.title: Your mobile number
number.what: Your 10-digit mobile number, with India's +91. It is also your login.
number.why: To log you in with a code we send by SMS, and to contact you about your bookings by SMS, WhatsApp or phone.
number.who: The garage, and the company that hosts the website and its database.
number.howLong: As long as you have a login with us. You can ask us to delete it.

consent.title: Your agreement
consent.what: That you said you're 18 or older and agreed to how we use your number, with the time, the language of the page and the version of this notice you were shown.
consent.why: So we can show what you agreed to, as the law asks.
consent.who: The garage, and the company that hosts the database.
consent.howLong: As long as you have a login with us.

attempts.title: Each request for a login code
attempts.what: Your mobile number, your device's network address (IP address) when the website can see it, the time, and the agreement you gave on the form.
attempts.why: To limit how many codes go to one number or one network, so nobody can flood a phone with texts, and to record your agreement until you log in.
attempts.who: The garage, and the company that hosts the database.
attempts.howLong: We delete these records once they're more than {hours} hours old, the next time anyone asks for a code. They aren't yet deleted on a timer.

codes.title: Login codes
codes.what: The 6-digit code we text you, and how many wrong tries were made.
codes.why: To check the code you type.
codes.who: The garage, and the company that hosts the database.
codes.howLong: A code works for {minutes} minutes. We delete it when it's used or when a new one is sent to your number; until then, an unused code stays in our records after it stops working.

session.title: Your login on this device
session.what: A random token that keeps you logged in (in a cookie on your device, and in our records), your device's network address (IP address), your browser's description (its user agent), and when the login ends.
session.why: To keep you logged in for up to {days} days.
session.who: The garage, and the company that hosts the database.
session.howLong: Until you log out. A login that simply runs out stays in our records until it's next used or we delete it; deleting these automatically is planned.

sms.title: The text message with your code
sms.what: Your mobile number and the message, which includes the code.
sms.who: The company that delivers SMS for us. We'll name it here before the website opens to customers.
sms.howLong: As long as that company keeps its delivery records. We'll say how long here when we name it.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: When you log in, the website sets one cookie, which keeps you logged in. It sets no advertising or tracking cookies.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, you can ask us to show you a summary of the personal data we keep about you and who we've shared it with, to correct it or bring it up to date, to delete it, or to let someone you name act for you if you can't. To ask, call or message us from the mobile number you log in with: that's how we check the request is yours.

withdraw.title: Taking back your agreement
withdraw.body: You can take back your agreement at any time: call or message us. We'll stop using your number and delete your login and the data above, except anything a law requires us to keep. You can't log in again unless you agree again.

contact.title: Questions and complaints
contact.body: Contact the garage: call <call>{phone}</call> or message us on <whatsapp>WhatsApp</whatsapp>. If you're not satisfied with our answer, you can complain to the Data Protection Board of India.

children.title: If you're under 18
children.body: Only people aged 18 or older can log in. If you're younger, please ask a parent or guardian to contact the garage for you.

changes.title: Changes to this notice
changes.body: If we change what we keep or why, we'll update this notice and its date, and ask for your agreement again the next time you log in.

TermsPage.metaDescription: The terms for using the {brand} website and visiting the garage in Kiwale, Pune: booking a visit, approving work before it starts and paying at the garage.
TermsPage.heading: Terms of use
TermsPage.draft: This is a draft. We're finalising it before the website opens to customers.
TermsPage.intro: These terms cover using this website and visiting {brand}, a garage at {address}. Parts that aren't decided yet are listed below.

booking.title: Booking a visit
booking.body: When you book, you're asking for a time to bring your vehicle to the garage. We confirm the time with you by phone or WhatsApp.

work.title: Work on your vehicle
work.body: We tell you what we plan to do, and the price, before we start. If we find something more that needs doing, we ask you first: we don't do extra work without your agreement.

paying.title: Paying
paying.body: You pay at the garage, in cash or by UPI. This website doesn't take payments.

login.title: Your login
login.body: You log in with a code we text to your mobile number. Keep the code to yourself: anyone who has it can log in as you. The <privacy>privacy notice</privacy> explains what we keep about you.

undecided.title: Not decided yet
undecided.body: Cancelling or moving a booking, any warranty on our work, and our responsibility for vehicles in our care will be added here before the website opens to customers. Until then, please ask us.
